policy: Every recovered BootEdit inventory entry and every byte in the initialized .text virtual range is assigned exactly once. product_application means code implementing BootEdit product behavior; it is not a claim of personal authorship, originality, or copyright ownership. Pinned Dear ImGui code is attributed rather than relifted. Compiler/XDK/CRT/import code and the two independently evidenced out-of-line standard-library templates are platform_toolchain. Where the present evidence cannot separate generic application support, third-party-derived adapters, and compiler emission, the entry remains unknown instead of being guessed into the product bucket.
scope_note: This artifact partitions the authoritative 934-entry size-to-next-symbol inventory and its complete byte extents. Normal linker padding belongs to the preceding recovered extent. A known non-pdata leaf inside one extent is separately recorded, but does not create overlapping byte ownership.

uncertainties: The 11-entry, 5,128-byte Xbox 360/DX9 backend is certainly distinct from unmodified ImGui core, but may mix adapted MIT imgui_impl_dx9 code with closed Xbox integration. Backend role alone is not source provenance, so it remains unknown.

Early theme/archive/framework helpers and generic C++ bodies interposed around named application functions remain unknown unless a product string, named call chain, or standard-library diagnostic proves ownership.

The 0x82052a88 packed-resource family checks XPR2, fixes 16-byte resource records, handles TX texture records, and is shared with SettingsApp. That establishes Xbox packed-resource role but not exact public/platform source provenance, so the family remains unknown.

The 0x82053238 inventory extent bundles a FindFirst-style wrapper, CreateThread wrapper, platform thunk, and XLNI symbolic-launch adapter. Two bodies normalize exactly to SettingsApp, but shared use and standard Xbox strings do not prove public/platform provenance, so the whole unsplittable extent remains unknown and is not source-covered as BootEdit product code.

The non-pdata packed-resource constructor at 0x82052a60 is embedded at the tail of the product-owned 0x82052830 inventory extent; under the inventory-granularity policy those 40 bytes inherit the containing extent instead of creating overlapping ownership.

The former product candidate at 0x820537e0 is Microsoft/XDK PAL-50 startup policy: it queries XAM/kernel configuration and selects from the embedded 16-language PAL-50 warning and localized confirmation-label tables before CRT entry. It is platform_toolchain, not Peer product code.
ColorsDifferExact at 0x82050a00 is a known non-pdata leaf inside the product-owned 0x82050958 inventory extent; it is not counted as a 935th inventory entry.
Product classification is component-level reconstruction priority, never a claim that a named individual personally authored the bytes.
